_comment: Run from a host with Docker after `scripts/demo.sh` has the stack up (infrastructure/docker-compose.demo.yml).
Set ERP_DB_CONTAINER (the postgres:17 container of the ERP) and container names below to match `docker ps`.
UNVERIFIED against a live stack: the e2e example was never built or run (INCREMENT-1.md). Build and run scripts/demo.sh first.
Poll interval is 100 ms, so each wait step has up to 100 ms quantisation; keep it in mind when reading small latencies.
Stock: each journey reserves QTY of a SKU from sku_pool. Seed enough stock for rate*duration*sessions or failures will be out-of-stock, not performance.

environment.note: record docker/WSL limits; compose files set no CPU/memory limits (report section 5)

probes.erp_outbox_oldest_unpublished_s: docker exec $ERP_DB_CONTAINER psql -U erp -d erp -Atc "select coalesce(extract(epoch from now()-min(created_at)),0) from erp_temporal_event_outbox where published_at is null"
probes.erp_outbox_backlog_rows: docker exec $ERP_DB_CONTAINER psql -U erp -d erp -Atc "select count(*) from erp_temporal_event_outbox where published_at is null"
